scope: Local recurrent-v1 quality gate; does not authorize mainnet
state_policy: Initialize once; carry hidden state and generated token across every word. No reset on terminal punctuation, no forced completion, no stored response selection.
decision: Report every output. A lower validation loss or zero repeated ngrams alone is not a quality pass.
human_dimensions: Local grammar: complete natural clauses and valid agreement, without incoherent word salad
Cross-sentence continuity: actors, objects and motives remain interpretable across at least three sentences
First-person voice: coherent original comic or reflective personality rather than a stream of domain nouns
Repetition: no persistent repeated phrases, sentence patterns or semantic restart loop
Originality: disclose exact normalized training matches; this test does not prove semantic novelty
comparison: Compare FP32 against independently implemented Q10 inference and actual v4 gas. Language quality and gas are separate gates.
risk: ReLU recurrence may lose or saturate memory. H265/4.49M includes large embeddings and tree output tables; parameter count alone does not imply transformer-like reasoning.
